## About
Miller Enterprize Automotive Service is a small repair shop off the alley behind the storefronts on Irving Park Rd. We handle everything from a rattling muffler or air-conditioning that has gone on strike to motor repairs and body work, across a wide variety of vehicle makes.
Steve runs the shop, and we are a small shop where the customer comes first. Customers have given us a 4.9 rating from 23 Google reviews, and reviewers talk about being told straight what a car needs and what it will cost.

## Services
- General auto repair: All kinds of repair work, including the small problems that pop up day to day.
- Body work: Minor or major damage repaired across a wide variety of vehicle makes, along with mechanical work.
- Maintenance and inspections: Routine maintenance and car inspections, including winter inspections.
- Brakes and tires: Brake work, tire changes and winter tire service.
- Computer-aided engine diagnostics: Finding out what is going on with your car before we start any work.
- Air-conditioning service: Getting your air-conditioning working again when it gives out.
- Glass and chip repairs: Repairs for chipped or damaged glass.
- Rental car assistance: Help sorting out a rental car while yours is with us.

## FAQ
Q: How do I find the shop?
A: Our entrance is off the alley at 1815 Irving Park Rd, behind the storefronts. When you arrive, ask for Steven.

Q: When are you open?
A: We are open Monday through Friday, 6:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and closed on Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can I reach you after hours?
A: Yes. Our shop phone forwards to a cell phone for after-hours questions and appointments.
